name: Team Charmander: Pyro Breaker & Fighting Momentum
archetype: Fire STAB incineration, 4x fighting wallbreaking, and electric coverage.
gym_duel_rationale: Kurt's 5v5 Gym battle prompts the player to select 5 active Pokémon: Primeape/Sandslash acts as the primary wallbreaker, unleashing STAB Close Combat to crush Blissey/Shuckle through its 4x Fighting weakness and using Earthquake against Slowbro/Scizor; Charizard/Venusaur incinerates Beedrill/Ariados and melts Forretress/Cloyster with 4x Flamethrower; Alakazam/Raichu shocks Slowbro/Scizor with Thunderbolt and outspeeds with Psychic; Gyarados/Nidoking blunts incoming physical attacks on entry with Intimidate; and Snorlax absorbs stray special blasts comfortably with Rest.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST hybrid anchor. STAB Flamethrower deals catastrophic 4x damage to Forretress/Cloyster and melts Beedrill/Ariados instantly.
522 BST physical pivot. Intimidate neutralizes opponent Attack on switch-in. Sets up Dragon Dance and washes away ground/rock threats.
500 BST speed demon with 120 SpA. Thunderbolt electrocutes Slowbro/Scizor and Kingdra hybrids, while STAB Psychic destroys Beedrill/Ariados.
477 BST wallbreaker. Vital Spirit prevents sleep. STAB Close Combat delivers massive 4x super-effective damage to crush Blissey/Shuckle.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Absorbs stray Dragon Pulses and special moves easily, recovering to full health with Rest and Sleep Talk.
535 BST Water/Ice wall. Provides immense bulk and Water Absorb healing during Slowpoke Well exploration.

flex_bench.rationale: High-Speed Flying pivot providing Tailwind speed doubling and super-effective Air Slash against wild bugs.
Levitate Ground immunity and high physical Defense with Sludge Bomb against physical attackers.
Iron Fist-boosted Fire Punch and Drain Punch for versatile bug-hunting tech.
